key.name: expand-on-hover
key.summary: Open the island when the pointer rests on it
key.description: Otherwise, click it (or press the shortcut) to open it.

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: How long the pointer rests on the island before it opens, in milliseconds

key.name: appearance
key.summary: The island's colour: true black, or the dark grey of GNOME's menus

key.name: lock-screen
key.summary: Show what is playing, and volume and brightness, on the lock screen

key.name: media
key.summary: Show what is playing

key.name: media-compact
key.summary: While music plays, the pill shows the artwork around the clock, the song title, or just the clock

key.name: track-peek
key.summary: Show the new song for a moment when the track changes

key.name: visualizer-color
key.summary: Colour of the bars: taken from the album art, or white

key.name: notifications
key.summary: Show notifications in the island instead of banners

key.name: notification-time
key.summary: How long a notification stays, in seconds

key.name: battery
key.summary: Announce charging, a full battery, and a low battery

key.name: low-battery
key.summary: Warn when the battery falls to this percentage (and again at 10% and 5%)

key.name: bluetooth
key.summary: Announce headphones and other Bluetooth devices connecting

key.name: focus
key.summary: Announce Do Not Disturb going on and off

key.name: calendar
key.summary: Show the week and your next events when the island is open

key.name: hud-volume
key.summary: Show volume changes in the island

key.name: hud-brightness
key.summary: Show screen brightness changes in the island

key.name: hud-keyboard
key.summary: Show keyboard backlight changes in the island

key.name: hud-microphone
key.summary: Show microphone changes in the island

key.name: hud-other
key.summary: Show GNOME's other pop-ups (airplane mode, touchpad, and the like) in the island

key.name: hud-style
key.summary: A smooth bar, or sixteen segments

key.summary: Show the level as a percentage too

key.summary: Open the island, or close it
